title: Counting the Travellers an Amendment Charge Is Charged For: the Combinations
content:
On a package among the Vacation Package Products the travellers an amendment charge is charged for may be counted otherwise than by simple head count, according to the discount lines standing on that package's ledger and the children shown on its record.

| Child discount lines against the package | Third-adult discount lines against the package | Children shown on the package record | How the travellers charged are counted |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 or more | either | 1 or more | the adults shown on the record alone |
| either | 1 or more | 0 | the adults shown on the record less the third adult sharing |
| either | 0 | 0 | not recounted on this ground |
| 0 | either | 1 or more | not recounted on this ground |

**First combination.** Where the ledger carries a child discount line against the package and the package record shows children travelling, the travellers charged are counted as the adults shown on the record alone, the children being re-priced without a separate administration charge.

**Second combination.** Where the ledger carries a third-adult discount line against the package and the package record shows no children travelling, the travellers charged are counted as the adults shown on the record less the third adult sharing. One adult is taken off the count, not one place at a discounted share.

**Otherwise.** Where neither of those combinations holds, the travellers charged are not recounted on this ground.

The two combinations are read in the order set out: where a child discount line stands and children are shown on the record, that combination governs whatever the third-adult discount lines show.

*Worked hypothetically.* A package showing 2 adults and 2 children, with a child discount line standing against it, charges for 2 travellers. A package showing 3 adults and no children, with a third-adult discount line standing against it, charges for 2 travellers. A package showing 3 adults and 1 child with neither kind of discount line standing against it is not recounted on this ground.
